scope: 2024 CCPC Chongqing A B C D E H I J K M F G L
limitations: Independent exact small-instance checks; no online submissions or maximum-scale timing.

A.method: all subsets of random small arrays; exact integer totient versus grouped small-prime DP, including repeated large primes and ones

B.method: high-precision Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP oracle and both official samples

C.method: all nonempty first/last rows for widths 2..7; BFS eight-connectivity and exact bounding rectangles of every four-component

D.method: all reduced fractions through denominator 44 with bounded denominator 90; enumerate every denominator and numerator and inspect reduced decimal denominator

E.method: exhaustive legal contraction search on random connected odd graphs through 7 vertices, including cycles and equal maxima

H.method: literal formal transformation versus all three aggregated residue states; quotes, backslashes, punctuation, p=1, official second example

I.method: all multisets over 1..4 through size 8 and random 1..9 multisets; exact full expression-partition DP with both operators

J.method: all 24 orientations and eight three-roll macros; full orientation/position BFS on three small grids

K.method: explicit recursive matrices through n=4, all coordinates versus ternary digit condition

M.method: literal median-operation BFS, exhaustive bounded assignments, and large-range median symmetry oracle for interpolation

F.method: all firing permutations for all directions through n=5 and random n=6,7; interval-chain DP; all three official samples

G.method: literal all-target shooting for all small permutations, plus independent naive polynomial multiplication/long division for the prefix-product tree; excludes NTT implementation

L.method: sorted-event recurrence and top-down firing counts versus literal legal queue stabilization; random trees, paths/stars at maximum stable mass, both official samples; excludes optimized persistent/rollback treap
